newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-AUXERRE'S RABARIVONY PULLS OUT OF AJAX MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AUXERRE'S RABARIVONY PULLS OUT OF AJAX MATCH.

text.p: Injured Auxerre left back Franck Rabarivony has pulled out of a European Champions' League match against Ajax Amsterdam on Wednesday, clubs sources said on Tuesday.
Rabarivony, who has not fully recovered from a calf injury, was declared unfit to play by team doctors after Auxerre's last training for the match. He will be replaced by young Eric Assati.
Auxerre were already without defenders Ned Zelic, who is injured, and suspended international Alain Goma.
